whoItsFor: People who chat on WhatsApp, QQ, Feishu, or X and want help reading the other person's intent and risk before replying. It suits users on Android, Windows, or macOS, and iOS users who build the keyboard themselves.
useCases: Check what the other person really means and how risky a moment is before replying
Get ranked reply drafts and tap one to fill it into the message box, then press send yourself
Use a custom iOS keyboard to see intent, risk, and replies for copied messages

requirements.os: Android 11 or later (Chinese edition needs ARM64); Windows 10 1903 or later, or Windows 11; macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon; iOS requires building from source with Xcode
